lessons: Run as advised, the matched contracts would have made ₹3,23,424; ck netted ₹55,866 after ₹42,261 charges, and the whole book including unmatched manual trades was −₹1,848.

Slippage of −₹2,56,320 was hand execution: Zen alone −₹1,03,943 (four days of ₹17-25k worse exits: 24 Jul, 4 Sep, 28 Sep, 30 Sep), then Ratio-Weave −₹56,602, Ratio-Fluxer −₹51,555, IV-Imbalance −₹26,605, Curvature −₹25,945.

Missed legs cost −₹81,507 net: one-legged spreads lost on Delta-Ripple (−₹1,12,889), Convex (−₹57,983), Ratio-Fluxer (−₹51,480), Damper (−₹39,699) and Zen (−₹34,200); IV-Imbalance's missed legs happened to save ₹52,978.
Sizing helped +₹1,12,529 only because ck was 0.13-0.17x on losing naked buys (Prudent, SkewHunter, Burst RR); on winners being under-sized cost IV-Imbalance −₹98,579 and Zen −₹47,645.
Auto at small size plus a mechanical copier removes all three leaks; no manual trades on algo contracts.
